review.note: Transcribed for riia-1 from the cited ITU-R Recommendations by the implementer, without the primary texts open. Every level, time percentage and pattern parameter must be checked against the cited version by a person before results are relied on.

rules.reason: Passive sensors of EESS/space research are spaceborne, not Finnish ground receivers
Other space services (amateur-satellite, EESS, space research, space operation, inter-satellite, standard frequency) have no ground receiver class in riia-1
